source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 31, 2026 , there were 154,423,421 shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding ( 162,030,348 on a fully diluted basis, including 7,606,927 Class B-2 common units of a consolidated subsidiary, BlackRock Saturn Subco, LLC, which are exchangeable on a one-for-one basis into common stock of the registrant).

notes: Common stock only, listed on the NYSE as BLK. Left out: 7,606,927 Class B-2 common units of a consolidated subsidiary, BlackRock Saturn Subco, LLC ('Subco Units', issued as HPS acquisition consideration), which the 10-Q cover counts in a fully diluted total of 162,030,348 and which are exchangeable one-for-one into common stock. They are equity of a subsidiary (redeemable noncontrolling interest), not BlackRock common stock, so they are excluded under the common-equity-only rule; including them would add 4.9% to the count. BlackRock has no preferred stock outstanding.
